name: tom
message: We arrive on the 20th. Is breakfast included in our booking? And can we still cancel if our plans change?
summary: Guest asks if breakfast is included and if cancellation is possible; booking is non-refundable, no breakfast. Answered per policy.
reply:
Hello Mr Becker. Your booking for 20–22 November doesn't include breakfast. You can add it in advance for €12 per person per day. If you add it at check-in, it costs €14. Breakfast is served from 07:00 to 10:30, and children under 6 eat free.

Your Suite is on the non-refundable rate, which is already paid. It can't be cancelled for a refund, and a no-show isn't refunded either. If your plans change, you can move the stay once to new dates within 6 months. That depends on availability and has a €25 change fee.
